name: cc-side-context
description: See what is eating your Claude Code context, live in a side pane, and fix it in one key: top context eaters, prompt-cache countdown, compaction that keeps your decisions, handoff notes

qualityBudget.title: Quality budget (tokens)
qualityBudget.description: Warn and suggest compacting once context passes this many tokens, before auto-compact would. Long conversations tend to lose early details well before a 1M window is full. 0 turns it off.

smartCompact.title: Smart compaction
smartCompact.description: Tell every compaction to keep your goal and rules, changed files, decisions and the next step.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives, for the countdown. auto takes 1h on a subscription and 5m on an API key.
